newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to launch new station wagon Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to launch new station wagon Oct 3.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday it will launch a new station wagon, the Stagea, in Japan on October 3.
Competing with Volvo and Mercedes-Benz models, it will be sold only in Japan, with a monthly sales target of 5,000 vehicles, Nissan president Yoshikazu Hanawa told a news conference.
The domestic market for large station wagons is at present only about 1,000 vehicles a month, he said, but Nissan expects to sell more than that because of its relatively lower prices.
The Stagea will sell for between 2.27 million yen and 3.16 million yen, he said, while Volvo's 850 Estate ranges from 4.10 million yen to 5.70 million yen.
